title: Tiger Prawns with Uruguayan-Style Skewers
description: A delicious German-inspired dish featuring tiger prawns grilled to perfection on skewers with a hint of Uruguayan flair.
instructions: Alternate tiger prawns and Uruguayan sausage on skewers.
Place skewers on grill and cook for 8-10 minutes per side, or until prawns are pink and cooked through.
Meanwhile, brush charred onions and vibrant bell peppers with oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill onions and bell peppers for 5-7 minutes per side, or until tender.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
